title: DerefMut Abuse for Silent Mutable Coercion
pattern: Implementing the `DerefMut` trait on domain models to allow callers to unsafely and implicitly mutate internal fields.
why_bad: It breaks the encapsulation of mutable state. Callers can modify inner attributes without traversing the outer struct's business rules or invariants, leading to silent state corruption.
detection: An implementation of `DerefMut` where the outer type is a business domain model rather than a standard memory wrapper or smart pointer.
